blockingFindings.title: Mismatch tests can pass by falling back to the only active flow
blockingFindings.target: specs/320-add-target-identity-binding-to-flow-get-runtime-/tests/runtime-log-target-identity.test.js: R3 test "reports each local target identity mismatch without log content"
blockingFindings.issue: Each mismatch case supplies only the mismatched identity value in a project with a single active flow. An implementation that falls back to the sole active flow and then reports ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH would pass, without proving that the command first resolved a target from a supplied matching identity and rejected the other supplied mismatched expectations.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add mismatch cases that include one correct expectation to resolve the target plus one incorrect expectation, for example `--expect-run-id run-438 --expect-issue 999`, `--expect-issue 438 --expect-spec 999-wrong`, and/or `--expect-spec 438-target --expect-run-id wrong-run`.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R2 and R3 require every supplied expectation to match and mismatched input must not fall back to another flow. The current test has a static anti-pattern that can pass while relying on fallback behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Run-ID ownership filtering is not covered for selectors after target resolution
blockingFindings.target: specs/320-add-target-identity-binding-to-flow-get-runtime-/tests/runtime-log-target-identity.test.js: R5 test "preserves raw, JSON, and block-selector contracts after target match"
blockingFindings.issue: The R5 selector test writes only `run-438` blocks into the resolved target log. It does not include another run ID's block in the same log file with a competing latest sequence or requested sequence, so an implementation that selects by file/sequence without filtering blocks by the resolved target run ID would still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add at least one foreign-run block to the resolved target log and assert default latest, `--sequence`, and/or `--run-id runId#sequence` do not return that foreign block after the target identity resolves to `run-438`.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R5 explicitly requires selecting only blocks owned by the resolved target run ID. Without this regression, a critical data-disclosure and wrong-selection risk is untested.

blockingFindings.title: Mutation snapshot contradicts the allowed command-log append
blockingFindings.target: specs/320-add-target-identity-binding-to-flow-get-runtime-/tests/runtime-log-target-identity.test.js: R6 test "leaves flow and runtime-log files unchanged on success and mismatch"
blockingFindings.issue: The test snapshots the whole `.tmp/logs` tree before and after runtime-log reads. R6 allows the dispatcher's established command-log append, so this assertion can fail for valid behavior if that append is stored under `.tmp/logs`, or it can force implementation to suppress established logging.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Narrow the assertion to the runtime-log file and relevant flow/spec/metadata/artifact files, or explicitly exclude the dispatcher command-log path from the snapshot comparison.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A test that encodes behavior stricter than the requirement can block a correct implementation and contradicts the target API contract.
